verdict.rationale: Turso's docs say vector search is native with no extensions required. You store embeddings alongside relational data and query them with built-in distance functions (turso-docs-44, turso-docs-36), and the AI-memory guide uses this for retrieval. A Turso employee confirms vector search is a libSQL addition, and a community user notes the native support as an advantage over fiddly SQLite vector extensions, though another says the vector documentation could be more robust. Missing for 10: details on approximate-nearest-neighbor indexing and performance at scale, independent hands-on corroboration of similarity-search use, and deeper vector documentation.
